name: Simplex Booking Engine
author: ranisimplex

sections.description:
Simplex Digital Hotel Marketing LTD is a boutique software company based in Israel,
specializing in digital marketing solutions for hotels and hotel chains worldwide.

This plugin enables:
– Easy integration of the booking engine into WordPress pages.
– Customization of colors, button texts, and PMS connection settings.
– A mobile-friendly “Book Now” button for an optimal user experience.
– Full integration with Elementor for easy page editing.

Simply provide your hotel ID, configure the settings, and embed the booking engine on your website pages in just a few clicks!
Note: The hotel ID will be provide after PMS configuration and signing a work order accordingly. The plugin is for exiting Simplex Customers.
If you not Simplex customer yet you can refer to https://www.simplex-ltd.com/.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external JavaScript service to render booking engine components such as the reservation calendar and guest combination selection. It also uses an API to retrieve the availability of hotel rooms based on the ChainID provided by the user.

Data sent:
– ChainID: Provided by the user to identify the hotel chain for which room availability is being fetched.

External Service:
– This service is provided directly by the plugin author, “Simplex Digital Hotel Marketing LTD.”
– Terms of Use: https://www.simplex-ltd.co.il/wordpress-terms-of-use.pdf
– Privacy Policy: https://www.simplex-ltd.co.il/wordpress-privacy-policy.pdf

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simplex-booking-engine directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings by entering your hotel ID and customizing the options as needed.
sections.faq:
How do I get started with this plugin?

After signing up with Simplex and connecting to the PMS system, you will receive a hotel ID. Enter this ID in the plugin settings under the “chainid” field. You can then start customizing the booking engine’s colors, texts, and other settings through the Simplex Booking Engine settings screen.

Is this plugin compatible with Elementor?

Yes! The plugin fully integrates with Elementor, allowing you to easily embed and customize the booking engine on your website.

Can I customize the button and other design elements?

Absolutely. The plugin provides options for customizing button colors, texts, and more directly through the settings panel.

What should I do if the plugin doesn’t work as expected?

Ensure that your WordPress version and PHP version meet the plugin requirements. If you still encounter issues, contact Simplex support for assistance.
